canonical_initial_state: 17FR pending, overall pending, negative_invariants empty; no mutation by this proposal

criteria.title: Full traceable coverage
criteria.requirement: As a maintainer, I can trace every original manual chapter, appendix, menu, command and bundled utility to stable inventory IDs, version applicability and acceptance evidence; completion leaves zero unclassified entries.

criteria.title: Native documents
criteria.requirement: As a user, I create/retrieve/edit/save original WP 5.1 documents under FC-001 through FC-004 and FC-007; Story 1 is the acceptance basis.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: E1, E3, Q3, Q4 and all native code owners

criteria.title: Companion artifacts
criteria.requirement: As a user, I retain original formats for all read/written companion artifacts under FC-005; Story 4 compares artifacts in both apps.

criteria.title: Classic interaction
criteria.requirement: As an experienced user, I retain original command keys, menus, prompts, help, cancellation, repeat, display configuration, mouse actions and document windows; Story 2 compares sessions.

criteria.title: Editing and Reveal Codes
criteria.requirement: As a writer, I retain original cursor, block, protected text, copy/move/append, deletion/undelete, typeover, search/replace and code-editing semantics; Story 2 and editing inventory probes apply.

criteria.title: File operations
criteria.requirement: As a user, I retain original retrieval, save/overwrite, file lists, directories, backup/recovery, Fast Save, locking, comments, compare and exit behavior; Story 1 and file inventory probes apply.

criteria.title: Original conversions
criteria.requirement: As a user, I can use all documented original text and 4.2 conversion modes with their original formats, behavior and declared losses (FC-008).

criteria.title: Text formatting
criteria.requirement: As a writer, I retain attributes, fonts, kerning, initial codes, margins, alignment, tabs, positioning, hyphenation, spacing, numbering and measurement semantics; Story 3 and format inventory probes apply.

criteria.title: Pagination
criteria.requirement: As a writer, I retain original page breaks, paper definitions, numbering, keep rules, columns, headers/footers and notes; Story 3 compares page membership and geometry.

criteria.title: Structured documents
criteria.requirement: As a writer, I retain styles, outlines, tables and calculations, generated references, master documents, dates, labels and envelopes; Story 3 compares editing and generated results.

criteria.title: Graphics and equations
criteria.requirement: As a writer, I retain original graphics formats, boxes, captions, wrapping, rules, equations, editing and original conversion utility behavior; Story 3 compares native structures and printed geometry.

criteria.title: Macros and merges
criteria.requirement: As a user, I record/edit/run original macro and merge languages and original conversion utilities; Story 4 compares commands, expressions, variables, output and errors.

criteria.title: Data operations
criteria.requirement: As a user, I retain sorting, record selection, column math, spreadsheet import and links; Story 4 compares results and refresh behavior.

criteria.title: Language tools
criteria.requirement: As a writer, I retain original character identities, composition, language selection/resources, spelling/dictionaries, lookup/counts and thesaurus behavior; Story 4 and FC-006 apply.

criteria.title: Printing
criteria.requirement: As a user, I retain original print choices, quality, printer commands/resources, font substitutions, print jobs, printer utilities and print-to-disk behavior; Story 3 and print probes apply.

criteria.title: Document preview
criteria.requirement: As a user, I retain original page-inspection functions based on declared printer resources; Story 3 compares preview to original output.

criteria.title: Platform-dependent functions
criteria.requirement: As a user, I retain documented settings, startup options, network/shared-file workflows, shell/process and utility functions through explicit, tested Linux mappings; Story 4 applies.

criteria.title: No-edit preservation
criteria.requirement: 100% of accepted valid native no-edit fixtures save with identical length, SHA-256 and bytes.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and every changed parser/native/save boundary

criteria.title: Failure safety
criteria.requirement: 100% of declared failed-save and rejected-unsafe-edit scenarios leave original files intact; zero silent truncation, content loss or false-success results.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and every changed parser/native/save boundary

criteria.title: Bounded parsing
criteria.requirement: Zero crashes, out-of-bounds accesses or infinite loops in the committed malformed-input corpus; resource bounds and a reproducible fuzz budget must be declared before parser acceptance.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and every changed parser/native/save boundary

criteria.title: Evidence completeness
criteria.requirement: 100% of features claimed verified link durable reference/version/resource and test evidence; zero verified labels based only on manual text or self-comparison.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and every changed parser/native/save boundary

criteria.title: Layout fidelity
criteria.requirement: Zero unexplained page-break, numbering, or glyph-position differences in accepted reference scenarios under matched resources; any comparison tolerance must be justified and recorded before its test runs.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and every changed parser/native/save boundary

criteria.title: Platform and stack
criteria.requirement: Linux application in Go with Bubble Tea, as explicitly selected by the owner.

criteria.title: Permanent native formats
criteria.requirement: Original WP 5.1 document and companion formats remain durable; product name Wordling 5.2 does not change stored format versions. No required Wordling wrapper, sidecar or intermediary conversion.

criteria.title: Two missions
criteria.requirement: Complete plain WP 5.1 DOS parity precedes M2. PDF and newly chosen conveniences are M2; original features stay M1.

criteria.title: Licensing
criteria.requirement: Apache-2.0 for original contributions. External manuals, binaries, dictionaries and resources are not relicensed; committed fixtures require provenance and redistribution permission.

criteria.title: Exact reference declaration
criteria.requirement: Record executable edition, date, locale and hashes, environment and resources before accepting original-app comparisons. 5.1+ and Windows 5.2 are not the target.

criteria.title: No hidden scope cuts
criteria.requirement: Unresolved platform/resource/graphics behavior stays visible in M1; any exclusion or baseline change requires an explicit owner decision recorded in git.
Save native documents as original WP 5.1 files. No replacement container, private version, or required sidecar.
criteria.acceptance: Original WP 5.1 opens, edits, prints, and saves Wordling-created files; Wordling reopens the results.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: An untouched valid supported input saves byte-identically.
criteria.acceptance: SHA-256 and direct byte comparison, including prefix packets and embedded data. Opening must not silently normalize the source.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: Editing preserves unrelated codes, packet content, embedded resources, and semantic relationships.
criteria.acceptance: Targeted edit fixtures; binary differences explained; original-app retrieval and behavior checked. Offset/length changes are permitted when required, arbitrary normalization is not.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: Unknown or not-yet-supported structures are preserved. Unsafe edits/saves fail explicitly before replacing the original.
criteria.acceptance: Opaque-code and packet fixtures, reference checks, rejected-edit and failed-save scenarios with original bytes unchanged.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: Original companion artifacts retain their original formats wherever the app reads/writes them.
criteria.acceptance: Per-format fixtures and original-app checks for macros, styles, merge data, keyboard definitions, and user resources; scope expanded from manual research.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: Characters preserve their WP character-set identities and round-trip.
criteria.acceptance: Character-set corpus; unsupported input receives an explicit error or choice before modification, never silent replacement.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: Native saves are independent of conversion through another word processor.
criteria.acceptance: The Go format writer emits original-format data directly; external tools may be independent test witnesses only.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: Original export/conversion and print-to-disk modes retain their documented formats and semantics.
criteria.acceptance: Per-mode comparison against original output with encoding, resources, and conversion losses declared. These modes do not replace the native save format.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: A failed save must not corrupt the existing file.
criteria.acceptance: Tests for permissions, interrupted/short writes, full storage, and failed replacement; original backup conventions researched and preserved.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q3, Q4 and all applicable native/companion/conversion/print delivery owners

criteria.requirement: PDF is a new, optional M2 export. It never becomes the editable native document format.
criteria.acceptance: M2 PDF acceptance tests against the shared layout output and native-file preservation checks.
criteria.planned_evidence_owners: Q4: enforce M2 gate and optional-native-export boundary; M2 PDF tests deferred until accepted M1

negative_invariants.title: No-edit accepted native/companion preservation
negative_invariants.acceptance: Open/save accepted fixtures byte-identically, with direct bytes+length+SHA256 across full prefix/embedded data.

negative_invariants.title: Opaque relationship/edit refusal
negative_invariants.acceptance: Targeted edits preserve unrelated/unknown valid owners; unsafe edit fails before publication; original bytes untouched.

negative_invariants.title: Save/overwrite transaction failure
negative_invariants.acceptance: Permission/full disk/interrupted short writes/stale destination/failed replacement/refusal preserve original; truthful uncertainty where atomic guarantee cannot be proved.

negative_invariants.title: Private operation provenance
negative_invariants.acceptance: Wrong source/root/name/buffer/screen/revision/parent/run/request/transition/duplicate/foreign results cannot edit or publish; authentic errors distinguished from synthetic wrappers.

negative_invariants.title: Password/resource failure
negative_invariants.acceptance: Wrong password, malformed encryption, missing fonts/dictionaries/graphics/printer resources fail explicitly before modification; no silent character substitution.

negative_invariants.title: Concurrent/backup/recovery safety
negative_invariants.acceptance: Lock conflict, timed/startup backup failure, crash points and other-screen recovery preserve each original and correct dirty/history/receipt state.

negative_invariants.title: Parser bounds
negative_invariants.acceptance: Committed malformed/truncated/cyclic/deep corpus and declared fuzz budget cause no crash/out-of-bounds/infinite loop; rejection preserves untouched input.

negative_invariants.title: Presentation independence
negative_invariants.acceptance: Display palette/preview mode/resize/cursor/shell return do not mutate native bytes, print content, current cursor or dirty state except independently observed original effects.
